_comment: Units: suffix _m metres, _rad radians, _deg degrees, _s seconds, _nm newton-metres. Frame: world (= base_link). See docs/FRAMES.md. Relative paths are relative to mujoco_sim/ (the repo root is ..).

model._tcp_note: With gripper.enabled the TCP is the gripper tip centre (derived in build_scene from gripper.*); tcp_local_pos_m/tool_length_m below are the old flange-face TCP and are used only when the gripper is disabled.
model._source_note: The tracked 6dof_description package (from branch urdf@b2b4038) is used with one change: 2026-10-24 (user request) every joint origin moved 2 mm along its axis toward the child, so adjacent parts have a 2 mm face gap (meshes unchanged; urdf, xacro, 6dof_mj.urdf, 6dof.xml, 6dof_control.xml). Other additions are generated/added files only.

desk._note: 2026-10-12: light wooden desk under the robot. World frame unchanged: the desk TOP SURFACE is at z = 0 (the plane the robot stands on, targets are marked on it); the grey floor is lowered to top_z_m - height_m. Static body: robot-desk contacts are checked normally, no exclusion added (see src/pinch_sim/scene_env.py).

mount._note: 2026-10-28 user: the robot stands on a 180 x 180 x 20 mm grey plate centred on the J1 axis (its front edge on the paper's robot-side edge, its sides on the +-9 cm lines). World z = 0 stays the table top: base_link and the arm are raised by height_m (base bottom at z = 0.02); joint angles, x and y are unchanged (scene_env.add_mount). The plate is a static body: it collides with the arm (and counts in the floor clearance), not with the base.

ready._note: Home in joint space: Revolute_1 = 0 (J2 axis = world +X), Revolute_6 = -0.139769 (keeps the gripper roll visible); 2026-10-11 lowered 5 cm in z (J2..J5 re-solved with J1, J6 locked). tcp_m = FK of q_rad, checked at build time. 2026-10-28: the robot stands on the 20 mm plate (mount), same q_rad -> tcp_m z 0.25 -> 0.27 (table frame). 2026-10-28 user: lowered 5 cm again, z 0.27 -> 0.22 (J2..J5 re-solved with J1, J6 locked; was [0, 0.641283, 1.312362, -0.899717, -1.570796, -0.139769]); 0 contacts, self clearance 11.8 mm, floor 43.6 mm. The real arm's HOME (robot.yaml home.q_rad) is -1 x this.

side_cam._note: 2026-10-13: at (0.3, 0.5, 0.3); heading 220 deg (old -X view turned +50 deg, then -10 deg about world Z; positive = counter-clockwise from above), pitched 20 deg down (30 -> 20, raised 10 deg on 2026-10-13); lookat = where the optical axis meets the desk top (z = 0).

cameras._size_note: 2026-10-12: 16:10 render (768x480). fovy stays 60 deg (vertical), so the view only widens sideways; the camera pose and the 3-D -> 2-D projection model are unchanged.

target._new_theta_note: N (New) presses cycle through these theta bands (deg, from +Y towards +X): 1st, 3rd, ... use the first band, 2nd, 4th, ... the second. The automatic target at program start is not counted and uses +-theta_max_deg. Redraws stay inside the band of that press; the radius range is unchanged.

limits._joint_speed_plan_note: planning aims the fastest joint at 0.99 x cap (22.275 deg/s): planned exactly at the cap, the computed-torque tracking peaked at 22.51 deg/s (+0.04 %) in the dry rollout. Validation checks planned and observed speeds against the cap itself.
limits._joint_speed_note: 2026-10-12: cap of the FASTEST driven joint (22.5 deg/s = pi/8 rad/s). The whole joint trajectory is time-stretched by one common factor so the fastest joint peaks at this value: every joint keeps its share of the motion and all arrive together; motions already below the cap are not slowed. Converted to rad/s only in model.joint_speed_max_rad_s(); planning (trajectory), validation (joint_vel_acc, sim_rollout observed |qvel|) and this note use that one value.

_calibration._note: Plan proposals vs values used after measurement (2026-10-10, MuJoCo 3.15.0). Evidence: logs/measure_hold.json, logs/workspace_scan.json (143 grid targets, all 12 checks incl. rollout), logs/render_views.json.
_calibration.target.work_height_m: 0.05 kept: 143/143 grid points pass incl. mesh collision; moving-link floor clearance measured in workspace_scan
_calibration.ready: q_ready = IK of (0, 0.20, 0.22) tool down, kept; 0 contacts, self clearance 9.0 mm, floor 41.6 mm
_calibration.ik.pos_tol_m: 1e-4 -> 1e-7 (axis 0.1 -> 1e-5 deg): IK jitter of 1e-4 rad between 10 ms samples produced spline accelerations up to 2.7 rad/s2 and forced 3-4.5x time stretch; with exact null-space projection IK converges in ~5 iterations
_calibration.limits.sigma_min_m_per_rad: 0.02 kept: workspace min 0.089 m/rad, singular stretched arm (q=0) ~0
_calibration.control.friction_comp: added: wrist inertia x Kp x error << dof_frictionloss 0.01 N*m, without it a 0.02 rad wrist offset did not settle in 2 s; with it settles in 0.15 s
_calibration.control.hold_drift_rad: 1e-3 kept as test bound; measured 0.0 over 10 s (model-matched computed torque + static friction)
_calibration.target.r_max_m: 0.30 -> 0.40 (2026-10-11 user request): 273/273 grid points (r 0.20-0.40 / 0.01, theta +-30 / 5 deg) pass all 12 checks; duration 3.2-6.3 s, tau max 2.67 N*m, sigma_min 0.089
_calibration.target.r_max_m_2026-10-12: 0.40 -> 0.30 (2026-10-12 user request, with r_min 0.25); logs/workspace_scan_r025_030.json: 78/78 grid points (r 0.25-0.30 / 0.01, theta +-30 / 5 deg) pass all 12 checks, duration 6.5-9.7 s
_calibration.ready.tcp_m: [0,0.20,0.22] -> [0,0.10,0.30] -> [0.0905,0.10,0.30] with Revolute_1 locked at 0 (2026-10-11 user request: J2 axis (1,0,0) at home; x=0 is not reachable with J1=0 and tool down) -> FK of the previous home joints after the 90 deg gripper roll (2026-10-11) -> roll -90 and z lowered by 0.05 m (2026-10-11) -> same joints, FK after the 2 mm joint gaps: +2 mm x, +2 mm y (2026-10-24)
_calibration.ik.damping_off_below: added 2026-10-11 with the gripper: DLS damping 1e-3 is switched to 1e-10 once the task error < 1e-3; with the tip 1.8 mm off the J6 axis the ready IK (J1 locked) otherwise stalled at 0.3 mm

editor._note: pac_path_editor correction parameters (algorithm from ../path 편집/src, imported unchanged); lengths in m, radius in side_cam render pixels
editor._input_note: 2026-10-11: edits change only the height z of the picked point (x, y fixed); mouse heights outside input_z_range_m are ignored (validation still decides feasibility).

gripper._note: Replaces the geometry/inertia of body housing_1 (child of Revolute_6, which is kept). Mesh in mm (80x80 face = housing_1 80x80 face). Mount face = 80x80 plate at mesh z_min; tip = 25x6 mm end at mesh z_max.
gripper._quat_note: Rx(-90 deg) * Ry(-90 deg) (2026-10-11 user: roll -90 deg about the tool axis): mesh +z (mount->tip) -> body -x (J6/tool axis), mesh +x -> body +y, mesh +y -> body -z.
gripper._mass_note: ASSUMPTION: solid PLA 1.24 g/cm3 x mesh volume 177.3 cm3 = 0.22 kg, uniform density, inertia computed by MuJoCo from the mesh. Not measured.
gripper._rgba_note: same rgba as the original links (rendered white/light grey)
gripper._fingers_note: 2026-10-28 user: fingers black. Drawing only: gripper.stl split into its connected components (body = mount plate + housing, fingers = the two tip prongs; triangles unchanged) drawn as two visual geoms. The collision geom keeps gripper.stl (mass, inertia, hull unchanged) in group 3 (hidden), so it is not drawn over the fingers.
